text_block_list.text:
One day, after Katsuragi Ace and I had
claimed victory in numerous races—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Aaah!
Come to think of it, she totally called it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: A hot springs trip!

The hot springs trip voucher won in the raffle...
I told her that right now was the perfect time
to use it as a "special reward."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't said something, Trainer,
I would've completely forgotten.
choice_data_list: A perfect reward for all your hard work!
A perfect reward for all your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heheh, you think so~?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "True, you've worked so hard, after all! Together with Trainer these past three years..."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: No! The only thing to do now is go all out and refresh myself!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
Let's have some fun, Trainer!
And so, transferring from local bus to local bus, I arrived at a hot spring town with Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the atmosphere here is awesome!
Traditional inns just feel so right.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Right♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Alright! Time to stroll around town before hitting the bath! Let's go have some fun!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's a ton of souvenirs.
……Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Trainer, look at that!

Plush keychains of what seemed to be local mascots were lined up outside the shop.
However, what caught my eye was the motif...
choice_data_list: A cat... no, a bird... no, a frog?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, it looks totally hideous!
Yikes~.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Lookin' pretty cute!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's buy this!
They come in a matching pair and everything.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I think it'd look super cute
attached to a backpack or something!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha, come on, why not!
Just think of it as a souvenir from the trip!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, ma'am!
Could I get that keychain, please?!

And so, the two of us spent the morning
exploring the hot spring town—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Aaah... That felt so refreshing!
choice_data_list: That was a wonderful bath, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Aaah~.
It's been so long since I had such a relaxing soak!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haaah, this is pure bliss.
choice_data_list: Glad to see you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Just a little more?
choice_data_list: Then shall we go get something to eat?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ah... yeah!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So, once we're done eating,
wanna head back outside?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: The lady at the souvenir shop told me! Apparently, the ocean is really close to here!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Let's go take a look!
"And so, after our meal, we came down to the sea. I thought we were just going to take a leisurely stroll, but—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: It's the ocea—n!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I told you we were gonna have a blast, didn't I!
Let's check out all the way over to the edge!"
choice_data_list: After we took the time to soak in the hot springs and everything?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You can just get back in!
Come on, hop to it!

I frantically chased after Katsuragi Ace.
At first I was deeply confused, but as we sprinted at full speed...—

My warmed-up body grew even hotter.
The night wind against my cheeks felt so good as I ran with reckless abandon. And then—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Whoa~... Incredible.

Before we knew it, both of us had collapsed onto the sandy beach.
A sky full of stars flooded our field of vision.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.

I glanced sideways to see Katsuragi Ace
lying on the ground, looking back at me with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Glad to see you're having fun!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: You worked crazy hard too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Gettin' a reward together... kinda makes me feel embarrassed, but hey.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I still have
a dream I want to make come true.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Your dream ain't over yet either, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So I don't know
when that'll be, but...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Let's hang out again!
Until we drop!

It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond
with Katsuragi Ace...
